summary: Frontend-only testing of Drill Spec Expo/React Native app on mobile viewport (375x667). All 10 requested flows PASS. Home renders brand, gear, and 2 cards. Settings shows 4 themes; theme change persists across reload (Blueprint stayed active). Calculator: inches (D=0.25, A=118) -> 0.0751 (expected 0.0751), mm (D=6.35, A=118) -> 1.908 (expected 1.908). Empty diameter shows calc-error. Drills screen renders 436 rows with 5-column layout; search '1/4' returns 2 rows; clearing restores 436. Filter chips work (Fractional=68, Metric=245). Drill row taps open detail with diameter values and designation cards (screwMachine/jobber/taper as available). Back button returns to previous screen on all non-home screens.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is solid: proper StyleSheet.create via makeStyles, all text wrapped in Text, testIDs on all interactive elements, KeyboardAvoidingView + keyboardShouldPersistTaps in Calculator, FlatList with initialNumToRender/windowSize/removeClippedSubviews for 436-row performance, and AsyncStorage-backed ThemeProvider with correct hydration effect.
Minor: Calculator errorText color uses colors.error; on some themes contrast is acceptable, no fix required. formula/tagline copy is readable.
seed_data_creation: None. Static bundled JSON with 436 drill entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://drill-spec.preview.emergentagent.com. Use mobile viewport 375x667. Key testIDs: app-brand, settings-gear-btn, home-calculator-card, home-drills-card, theme-{dark|carbon|light|blue}, unit-in/unit-mm, input-diameter, input-angle, calculate-btn, calc-result-value, calc-error, drills-count, drills-search, clear-search-btn, filter-{ALL|Fractional|Wire|Letter|Metric}, drill-row-{index}, drill-title-block, drill-diameter-in/mm, designation-{screwMachine|jobber|taper}, back-btn. Note: during route transitions two back-btn elements may briefly coexist; use .first when clicking.
